image_description: Two dogs playing in a snowy backyard. The dog on the right is standing upright on its hind legs, displaying a reddish-brown coat and a visible ridge along its spine. The dog on the left is smaller, wheaten-colored, and walking on all fours. Background includes bare trees, a fence, and a house.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'ridge' feature. In AI images, this is often faked as a simple dark stripe rather than reversed hair texture. Also, scrutinize the paws in the snow; AI often fails to render the physical displacement of snow under weight. The upright pose is rare for this breed—ensure it doesn't result in anatomical distortions like elongated torsos or fused joints.
